story.zh: 周瑜箭伤方愈。为夺回江陵，周瑜再设奇谋——
story.en: Zhou Yu has just recovered from his arrow wound. To reclaim Jiangling, Zhou Yu devises yet another ingenious scheme—

trigger.zh: 江陵属刘备，建业、柴桑属孙权。诸葛亮、赵云、周瑜、孙尚香、孙权、吴国太存活且属于正确势力。孙尚香未婚。主角不为吴国太、孙尚香。
trigger.en: Jiangling belongs to Liu Bei, Jianye and Chaisang belong to Sun Quan. Zhuge Liang, Zhao Yun, Zhou Yu, Sun Shangxiang, Sun Quan, and Wu Guotai are alive and belong to their respective factions. Sun Shangxiang is unmarried. The protagonist is neither Wu Guotai nor Sun Shangxiang.

participate.zh: 【身属刘备势力】，或【身属孙权势力】
participate.en: 【Belongs to Liu Bei's Faction】, or 【Belongs to Sun Quan's Faction】

defy.zh: 【<刘备势力>与孙权的关系等级小于4级且至少为2级，且声望至少为15000，代替刘备迎娶孙尚香】，【<孙权势力>与孙尚香关系等级至少为3且小于5并在切磋中战胜孙尚香，且主角不为周瑜、吕范、鲁肃，代替刘备迎娶孙尚香】或【<孙权势力>俘虏刘备并换取江陵】
defy.en: 【<Liu Bei's Faction> Relationship level with Sun Quan is less than Level 4 and at least Level 2, Renown is at least 15,000, and marry Sun Shangxiang in place of Liu Bei】, 【<Sun Quan's Faction> Relationship level with Sun Shangxiang is at least Level 3 and less than Level 5, defeat Sun Shangxiang in a duel, protagonist is not Zhou Yu, Lu Fan, or Lu Su, and marry Sun Shangxiang in place of Liu Bei】 or 【<Sun Quan's Faction> Take Liu Bei captive and exchange him for Jiangling】

force.zh: 刘备身为君主并占领城市<江陵>
force.en: Liu Bei is Ruler and occupies City <Jiangling>

force.zh: 孙权身为君主并占领城市<建业><柴桑>
force.en: Sun Quan is a Ruler and occupies the Cities of <Jianye> and <Chaisang>

force.en: Zhuge Liang and Zhao Yun return to Liu Bei's Faction

force.zh: 周瑜、孙尚香、吴国太回归孙权势力
force.en: Zhou Yu, Sun Shangxiang, and Lady Wu return to Sun Quan's Faction.
